name: home_care_robot
description: The home-care robot's DEME profile: the Design Guide's hard-shell pattern (section 5.1) over the guide's robot modules, Geneva at tier 0 as the base EM.
notes: Owner decisions carried: her voiced refusal binds while she can voice it, and her latest word on an act revokes the agreement's standing consent (AutonomyConsent 4.3.1 and the consent record); capacity is presumed (unknown counts as competent). Not yet carried, pending HumanOversight and Privacy modules: refer to the centre when it can decide in time; privacy holds except in a corroborated emergency; a guarded act she requests needs a human's approval.
